example.title: Example in Annecy
example.paragraph: Jennifer Geoffroy and her partner, in Annecy, have brought Eric's garden back to life, an octogenarian who could no longer maintain it. From this beautiful encounter was born an intergenerational collaboration, transforming this garden into a true sustainable ecosystem. Each space was redesigned taking into account environmental constraints and existing elements. The pond was redeveloped, hedges and vegetable areas gradually rehabilitated. Today, the garden is based on principles of resilience: permanent soil cover, layered crops providing shade for sensitive plants and ecological resource management.
